fixtures.note: beauty/cost inversion: cheapest proven route is the least verbose-renderable; exponential spec tree replaced by an in-place row DP
ratio grows with n (DP vs exponential); the strongest and cleanest SAIR cost table
per-row hoist of a precomputed nonzero pair list; DFS node counts identical (pure per-node constant factor)
measured negative: 3-sparse rows + forced diagonal give a 14,773-node mean tree vs 2^16 = 65,536 masks; the textbook-elegant route is >50x worse; measure search space before ranking by elegance
small-n parity nuance: ~2.4 s Mathlib import floor inverts the RAW ratio below 1.0 at n <= 300; base-subtracted deltas show the candidate already cheaper at n=600 (0.88 s vs 1.60 s)
O(n log log n) win discounted to the scored sizes (n <= 1000); fixed setup cost compresses the relative gain -- do not rank by big-O

fixtures.theorem: caRule110Spec: bit-parallel SWAR Nat word step (six endpoint cases)
fixtures.note: collapses per-cell list automaton into 14 bitwise operations on a single 256-bit GMP Nat word; ~36x across 6 cases and ~70x at 8 steps

fixtures.theorem: sha256Spec: typeclass-unwrapped schedule + flattened masks (512 steps)

kernelCost.axis: PMU perf stat -e instructions:u (billions of instructions)

fixtures.note: removes Fin/UInt32 typeclass wrappers and K.zip traversal; verified by user-space PMU instructions:u (39.43G vs 65.16G at 512 steps; 32-step wall 1.92s -> 0.77s)
measured negative (NR-024): kernel let bindings do NOT share across multiple syntactic occurrences during whnf/rfl reduction; unrolling schedule paid full cost per occurrence (1.8x slower)

fixtures.theorem: mertensSpec: odd-divisor WF-free structural factor scan (n=500)
fixtures.note: removes WellFounded.fix unfolding, dual factorization, and Finset overhead; reduces under plain rfl where Mathlib moebius requires with_unfolding_all

fixtures.theorem: mertensSpec: list-based mu-sieve with Nat.Prime filter (attempted)
fixtures.note: measured negative (NR-025): kernel reduction of List.filter Nat.Prime cost 45.41s alone at n=500 and per-element list marking regressed 14.8x

measured negative (NR-026): exact Int.ediv/Int.emod in Bareiss elimination is ~8.4x slower in the kernel than subresultant PRS; division-free determinants (Berkowitz/Mahajan-Vinay) are required instead

kernelCost.axis: PMU perf stat -e instructions:u (normalized to Nat.fastFib)

fixtures.note: measured negative (NR-027): apparent 0.67 wall-time ratio was an import-floor + defEq artifact; true PMU instruction count proved Lucas-pair 1.6-2.9% slower at every scored size because kernel cost is term-reduction-bound (~log2 n), while GMP bignum multiply is ~0.2% of delta

fixtures.theorem: fibSpec: point-free CPS Bool.rec + Top8 prefix tree + Nat.pow mpn_sqr (Top8SymProof)
fixtures.note: C++ kernel/GMP co-design: point-free CPS Bool.rec eliminates expr_kind::Let eager instantiate into untaken branches; closed 8-bit prefix lookup tree (F(128)..F(256)) eliminates 7 doubling levels and hK pair split; Nat.pow x (nat_lit 2) bypasses mpz.h:230 pass-by-value operator* copy so GMP invokes mpn_sqr directly across symmetric 3-squares doubling
